title: Соединение (переменные)
semantics: Combine exactly two ordered scalar variable sets: variable input 0 left, input 1 right, variable output 0. Preserve all values, labels and types; left variables precede right variables. Native automatic mapping allocates unique names: a0/a0/a1 become a0/a1/a2; duplicate title becomes title_1. Read actual generated names. integer/real/string/boolean and typed NULL only, at most 128 output variables. NULL differs from empty string, false and zero. Execute recomputes current inputs without training. Use W1 variable_inputs with kind variables and read.variable_ports:[0], not table inputs/read. Existing parameters:{} preserves settings and links; reject custom mappings, type conversion and dynamic inputs before mutation.

parameter_schema.description: Settings for the two initial variable inputs. New nodes use native automatic output mapping. An empty existing patch preserves the supported mapping.

column_union.description: Optional declaration of the supported output mapping. Other wizard settings and additional ports are outside this slice.

mapping.description: automatic keeps every source variable in input order and uses native unique names. Existing custom mappings require refusal, not silent resetting.
